declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)
declaration.question: With R1 / max 3 / B2 fixed, does the preregistered X2 momentum-continuation exit improve on the fixed 09:34 exit X1?

dataset.binding: the E-R2 .. M3 development binding, unchanged (480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16)
dataset.prechecks: re-run through app.backtest.strategy_e_max.prepare before any return
dataset.extra_bars: exact 09:44 ET aggregates read from the same bound view for selected symbol-sessions only; never a live-store glob

comparator.exit: exact 09:34 ET close (E-D3 FIXED_FIVE_MINUTE_CLOSE_PROXY_V1), fallback NONE

candidate.exit: E-D3 decides at 09:34; if that exit is VALID and close(09:34) > open(09:30) (raw prices) hold to the exact 09:44 ET close, else exit at close(09:34)

variants.implementation: app.strategy_e_max.exit_x2.execute (continuation=False reproduces capacity.execute; True applies X2 after the unchanged E-D3 resolver)
variants.decision_timing: the hold decision is taken once the 09:34 bar has closed (09:35:00 ET) and uses only the 09:30 open and the 09:34 close; no information from before the bar closes is assumed
variants.missing_0934: a position without a valid 09:34 exit cannot be evaluated and stays UNRESOLVED_EXIT exactly as in X1
variants.missing_0944: an extended position without a single valid exact 09:44 bar (missing, duplicate, invalid close, wrong session or symbol) is UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL; no fallback to 09:43, 09:45, the last print or the session close
variants.sizing_note: E-D5 classification and 1/n weights over standard-PnL-eligible positions, as in every earlier stage; an extended position that ends unresolved leaves the standard-PnL set
forbidden: trailing, ATR, highest-high or VWAP exits
changes to R1, capacity, B2 exposure, entry or cost

exposure: B2 unchanged: 1.5x on sessions with universe rows >= 100 and h5_rate >= 0.030741, else 1.0x; applied after the exit by app.strategy_e_max.breadth.scale

costs.limitation: the E-D4 cost is a time-independent total round-trip stress; a 09:30->09:44 hold (about 15 minutes) receives no additional slippage or holding cost

x1_reproduction: X1 must hash to the committed M3 B2 artifacts (trades and daily returns) before X2 is read
invariants: identical universe, H5, R1 order, selection, entry records and B2 exposure map for X1 and X2
positions not extended have identical records
delta_t = 0 on sessions without an extended position

improvement.paired: delta_t = X2 - X1 COST_10BP session return, all 480 sessions; metrics.bootstrap_mean_ci, IID, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921

winner.rule: X2 passing every eligibility and improvement condition -> X2 SELECTED; otherwise NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT and X1 is kept

m5_authorization.source: M0 exposure.precondition and stop condition A
m5_authorization.rule: M5 is AUTHORIZED when at least one of M1-M4 produced a winner (M1 selected R1 and M3 selected B2 before M4), stop conditions A and D do not hold, and the configuration carried out of M4 passes every M0 eligibility condition; otherwise NOT AUTHORIZED
m5_authorization.grid: M5 may only use the M0 multipliers 1.0, 1.5, 2.0

diagnostics.continuation: for extended positions with a valid 09:44 exit: 09:34 gross return, 09:44 gross return, incremental close(09:44)/close(09:34) - 1; mean, median, positive rate
diagnostics.tail_dependence: share of the total paired delta from the top 1, 3 and 5 delta sessions; diagnostic only
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four blocks: session mean, trades, compounded return, paired delta
diagnostics.stop_b: CAGR ratio X2/X1 vs MDD ratio |X2|/|X1|

reproducibility.required: identical exit decisions, trades, daily returns, metrics, bootstrap, verdict and result digest
